reply: Money stress is real and there is help on campus for it. Office of Financial Aid (One Stop Student Services Center) is the place for this, about 0.15 km from you; 973-353-1766. This week there is also Fresh Roots: free produce distribution at Paul Robeson Campus Center, Morris Room 227. Off campus: help with money and bills near you at https://uhnj.findhelp.com/money/all?postal=07102. Want me to narrow it down, or just keep talking?
